title: S09T05 - Run the five-user unassisted external beta
description: Recruit experienced agent-tool users, observe unassisted installation and one real workflow, then measure repeat use and comparative preference without coaching the desired answer.
acceptanceCriteria: At least three of five users install and reach useful output without maintainer intervention.
At least three of five use Boreal again one week later.
At least two prefer Boreal over their prior workflow and can name the concrete reason.
Every failure and abandonment point is logged as product evidence rather than explained away.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
